findings.reason: The protected implementation is a clean, iterative N-ary tree clone using an explicit stack of (original, cloned) node pairs. It allocates each child clone during the parent's child-list iteration, appending immediately to preserve sibling ordering. The explicit Node helper matches the standalone app contract, and no candidate is needed as the current implementation is optimal and concise.

The algorithm handles an empty root, allocates a unique Node copy for every node in the original tree, and wires every child pointer in exact left-to-right order. Because each non-root node in a tree has a unique parent, iterating over each parent's children processes every node and edge exactly once without shared references or shallow aliasing.

Every original node is paired, pushed, popped, and copied once, taking O(N) time across N nodes and N-1 total edges. The explicit stack and cloned tree nodes require O(N) space. The complexity artifact is inherited and hash-bound; this accelerated review did not inspect or recalibrate it.

Handles empty tree input by returning None, preserves integer values and ordered child lists, and allocates new Node instances throughout. The returned tree root matches the expected app-local representation without aliasing original objects.

The approach accurately details deep-copy node identity vs. shallow reference, derives the iterative stack traversal, proves structural and sibling order preservation, and documents O(N) time and space complexity. Alternatives and edge cases cover recursive DFS, BFS queues, identity maps for DAGs, repeated list concatenation, return of original root, empty trees, single nodes, wide roots, and deep chains.

The protected app source and immutable native source remain unchanged at canonical SHA-256 values 389e170d143e6d216192c4042c0896c571688626ab55db4e29ccd60371748b31 and 15018680db72b282b81c1abdc6c28e9468b2dfb9109629131d77aea774be9f6c. Both use the identical iterative stack algorithm, loop structure, and Node instantiation. Verified submission 2074765122 remains untouched.
